errors.evidence: The first country listed on the x-axis is "Франция" (France), not "Финландия" (Finland).
The list of categories on the x-axis omits "EC".
The label on the chart is the abbreviation "Обед. кралство" (United Kingdom), not the full name "Обединени кралства".

errors.text_span: Най-късите стълбове са с височина около 0%, докато най-високите са приблизително 5%.
errors.evidence: This statement misinterprets the data. The bars almost all represent negative values, with lengths corresponding to their magnitude. The longest bar represents the most negative value (approx. -21%). The highest value on the chart is slightly above 0%, and no bar reaches 5%.

errors.text_span: Например, стълбът за Финландия е с височина приблизително 0%
errors.evidence: This example is incorrect. The category is "Франция" (France), not "Финландия" (Finland), and its corresponding values are approximately -5.5% and -13.5%, not 0%.

errors.text_span: на някои от тях има повърхностен сив слой
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart, with a distinct solid blue bar for each category, not a gray layer on top of some bars. The color is also incorrect.

errors.text_span: а синият слой върху тях показва II тримесечие на 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the chart as having a stacked structure ("слой върху тях" - layer on them), when it is a grouped bar chart with bars placed side-by-side.
